candidate.name: O2b default Agent step wrapper trimming

canary.stop_reason: Case 116 repeated a non-infrastructure failed Workflow, then returned an empty plan and began authoring another Workflow.

case_results.summary: The answer passed the output contract. One internal request received an upstream Cloudflare 524 and no usage, so the Workflow token report is incomplete.
The repair replaced the conflicting flight with an exact self-driving candidate and the deterministic validator passed.
Restoring the complete textual output Artifact contract prevented the nested 'days' regression seen in O2.

The first Workflow failed when its repair Agent reached max_turns=12. The outer Agent immediately reran the same Workflow; the second run completed with an empty plan and the outer Agent began authoring another Workflow. This was not a network or process-infrastructure failure.

notes: O2b preserved the complete input/output Artifact contract, submit schema, custom Agent wrapper, and format correction behavior.
The batch stopped as soon as the non-retryable duplicate-Workflow and empty-plan failure made G2 impossible to pass.
The observed candidate input exceeded the entire six-case baseline before case 116 finished and before cases 138 and 161 started, so O2b also could not pass the token gate.
O2b was explicitly reverted before starting the independently attributable duplicate-run prevention candidate.
